title: What Interplanetary Internet 2.0 Is
definition: Interplanetary Internet 2.0: next-gen internet across the solar system.
description:
Interplanetary Internet 2.0 is next-gen internet across the solar system. It sits squarely in Future Communications & Interfaces, the frontier where DTN routers science becomes network logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are contact planning-scale. Societies that master network hulls early will shape bundle protocols practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why DTN routers programs worldwide now treat Interplanetary Internet 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

definition: Today's documented research behind Interplanetary Internet 2.0.

title: Readiness Estimator: Interplanetary Internet 2.0
definition: Estimates Interplanetary Internet 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Interplanetary Internet 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Interplanetary Internet 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Interplanetary Internet 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Interplanetary Internet 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 87192 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where DTN routers monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or bundle protocols maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Interplanetary Internet 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Interplanetary Internet 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Interplanetary Internet 2.0 — next-gen internet across the solar system.

Phase 1 — Prove (DTN routers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (bundle protocols): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (contact planning): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and solar system-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
